name: lc-first-time-land-interest
description: Saint Lucia first-time residential landowner interest deduction introduced by the July 2026 Income Tax Amendment No. 2 Act. Covers resident eligibility, the prior-ownership test, maximum parcel size, deed-registration date, qualifying paid interest and exclusion from the ordinary aggregate deduction cap. Use for a first residential land purchase, Saint Lucia land-loan interest relief or section 59D. It distinguishes an income deduction from a tax credit and from owner-occupied dwelling mortgage relief. It does not establish property transfer tax, registration charges, joint-borrower allocation or a taxpayer’s complete income tax position. Independent professional review remains outstanding.
